Multi-Center Cohort Provenance, Seven Uncertainty Operators, Locked In-Distribution Testing, and Cross-Domain Evaluation

g.text: Used EXCLUSIVELY for Phase 1 Threshold Calibration
Unseen holdout split for Phase 2 Evaluation
Siemens Elegra scanner | Dense lesion contours
Falsely penalizes large benign masses; dilutes tiny carcinomas
Excludes zero background, but still affected by speckle haze
• Area-Robust: ρ = -0.085 with area (Decoupled from tumor size)
Selected as primary triage policy metric
Band half-width w=2px; isolates contour transition zone
Strong boundary focus, but sensitive to pixel discretization
Averages only pixels with severe model disagreement
• Measures contour dissonance and texture heterogeneity
Operator Selection Verdict: U_fg Primary, U_std_fg Comparator
First-order moment preferred by Occam's razor given p=0.884
THREE-PHASE VALIDATION PIPELINE & AUDITED NUMERICAL RESULTS
Protocol Governance: Phase 1 Calibration → Phase 2 Locked Testing → Phase 3 OOD Transfer
Phase 1: In-Distribution Threshold Calibration (BUSI Validation Split, N=78)
• Prespecified primary operating point: coverage_80 (Target 80% coverage on lesion cases)
Phase 2: Locked In-Distribution Testing (BUSI Test Split, N=65 Lesion Cases)
• Evaluated with frozen parameters locked from Phase 1 (No recalibration permitted)
• Monotonic Risk Curve: Risk (1-DSC) strictly falls as coverage decreases (AUROC = 0.884)
Phase 3: Cross-Domain OOD Domain Shift Evaluation (4 External Cohorts, N=464)
• Zero-Shot Transfer: Frozen τ* = 0.064058 applied directly across all external centers
• 100% Non-Empty Integrity: Zero empty masks produced across all 464 scans (U_fg fully defined)
1. Safety Fail-Safe: Realized coverage drops gracefully from 72.3% (ID) to 51.3% (OOD) under scanner shift.
2. Robust Quality Retention: Retained DSC remains 0.8718 across unseen foreign ultrasound machines.
3. Risk Minimization: U_fg AURC (0.1267) vastly outperforms Random (0.2216) and U_mean (0.1864).
